{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check if any other rows have revenue '999,999.99' — just to be sure

actual_completed = len(df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != '999,999.99')])

actual_completed"}
